note: Expectations of the SQL parts of the PR brief that Node cannot run without a database. Read from server/src/modules/brief/infrastructure/repository.ts (d1c9093); orderings marked D5009 are fixed by the spec because Node leaves them undefined. Consumer: Go brief repository tests (S27, pgtest).

files.node: SELECT path, additions, deletions, patch FROM pr_files WHERE pr_id = $1 ORDER BY path (repository.ts:42) — database default collation
files.go: ORDER BY path, id (D5009: ties by id); the generator's flows feed files in the order the reader returns them, so the goldens do not depend on the collation
files.note: listed files are re-sorted by changed lines (stable), so this order only decides ties between equally changed files

currentReviews.node: SELECT DISTINCT ON (agent_id) id, agent_id, created_at FROM reviews WHERE pr_id = $1 AND kind = 'review' ORDER BY agent_id, created_at DESC (repository.ts:46-51); findings WHERE review_id IN (...) ORDER BY file, start_line (repository.ts:64); reviews then sorted newest first in memory
currentReviews.go: one review per agent (NULL agent_id one group), ties by id (D5009); findings ORDER BY file, start_line, id; dismissed findings included

cases.note: r5 is not kind=review; the deleted agents' reviews form one group (newest r3); newest first overall

enabledSkills: SELECT skills.id, skills.name FROM agent_skills JOIN skills WHERE agent_id = $1 AND skills.enabled ORDER BY agent_skills.order (repository.ts:74-81): link order; a disabled skill stays linked but is skipped

upsert.note: the whole PrBrief document; key order of the stored jsonb is not preserved, reads go through the contract (goldens/brief.json stored[])

read: pr_brief.json that fails PrBrief.safeParse reads as no brief: GET answers {brief:null, stale:false} (repository.ts:85-89); a read never errors on a stale shape
findPull: pull_requests JOIN repos WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND id = $2 -> {id, repoId, owner, name, title, body, base, headSha}; another workspace's PR is absent (404)
